hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Because t can be as large as 10^9 and alphabet size is only 26, model single-step shifts as a linear algebraic transformation.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Construct a 26 by 26 transition matrix where entry M[i][j] represents how many times character i generates character j in one cycle.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Use binary matrix exponentiation to raise the matrix to the power t modulo 10^9+7, then apply it to the initial symbol counts.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(26^3 * log(t) + n) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(26^2) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(26^3 * log(t) + n) complexity.
